notes: ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό is read as one noncompositional pair on together, headed on the governed word, with the intervening article its own unrepresented unit under rule 93.

The competing reading gives together to the συν- preverb of συνήχθησαν under rule 106 and leaves all three phrase tokens empty; it was rejected because it would strand the contentful αὐτό, and the unit's note names it.
